connection.write_scope: submit_feedback only adds a field report to a quarantined human-review queue; it never publishes or changes an operational grade

listing.name: MCP Queen
listing.tagline: Search MCP servers with current evidence
listing.description: MCP Queen is an evidence and discovery layer for the MCP ecosystem. Search servers and observed tool catalogs, inspect deterministic operational grades, and review dated Trust Receipt observations across security, data integrity, citation quality, claim verification, response behavior, and reviewed field reports. Operational grades measure observed availability, protocol behavior, tool discovery, latency, and provenance; they are not security, privacy, compliance, or data-quality certifications. Trust Receipt dimensions remain separate, and missing evidence is reported as unaudited rather than safe.

use_cases.title: Find an MCP server or tool
use_cases.description: Search public MCP server metadata and observed tool catalogs for a task, then filter results by operational grade, protocol access state, latency, or category.
use_cases.prompt: Find MCP tools for GitHub issue triage. Prefer open protocol access and show current operational evidence.

use_cases.title: Inspect a Trust Receipt
use_cases.description: Review a server's operational grade separately from dated security, data-integrity, citation, claim-verification, response-benchmark, and reviewed field evidence.
use_cases.prompt: Show the Trust Receipt for com.healthai/radar. Separate observed evidence from unaudited dimensions.

use_cases.title: Search dated evidence
use_cases.description: Search published evidence by topic or dimension and retain observation dates and source types instead of collapsing results into a composite trust score.
use_cases.prompt: Search MCP Queen for citation-quality concerns and include the observation dates.

data_handling.third_party_context: The service indexes public MCP Registry metadata, public server and repository links, observed public tool metadata, and dated observations. User tool calls query MCP Queen's database and do not proxy actions into listed third-party servers.
data_handling.request_metadata: The hosting provider may process standard request metadata. Searches and field reports may store limited abuse-control and usage metadata as described in the public privacy policy.
data_handling.field_reports: submit_feedback stores the named server, factual report, optional agent/client name, submission time, and a truncated one-way source-IP hash. Reports remain quarantined until human review.

tools.name: search_servers
tools.title: Search MCP Servers
tools.description: Search the MCP evidence registry using a natural multi-word task (e.g. 'reliable no-auth drug interaction server with citations'). Tokenizes and expands common synonyms, ranks metadata plus observed tool descriptions, and supports operational-grade/auth/latency/category filters. Use get_trust_receipt or search_trust_evidence for security, data, citation, claim, and response evidence.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search MCP Tools
tools.description: Search across the actual tools that graded MCP servers expose (their tool names and descriptions, captured live from tools/list) — not just server metadata. Use this when you need a specific capability or data type, e.g. 'get weather', 'query postgres', 'device recall', 'FDA 510k'. Returns the matching tools with the server that offers each, its grade, and the remote endpoint so you can connect directly.

tools.name: list_grades
tools.title: List Operational Grades
tools.description: List the top graded MCP servers from the mcpqueen registry (deterministic probe grades with evidence). Returns grade, score 0-100, latency, tool count and auth state per server.

tools.name: get_server_grade
tools.title: Get Server Grade
tools.description: Get the full grade and verbatim probe evidence for one MCP server, by its official registry name (e.g. 'com.healthai/radar').

tools.name: get_trust_receipt
tools.title: Get Trust Receipt
tools.description: Get one MCP server's complete evidence receipt: operational grade, deterministic security/data-integrity/citation/claim observations, and reviewed real-usage field reports. Missing observations are explicitly unaudited, never treated as a pass.

tools.name: search_trust_evidence
tools.title: Search Trust Evidence
tools.description: Search published MCP trust evidence and reviewed real-usage field reports. Use for questions such as which servers expose citations, have access caveats, make unverifiable corpus claims, or show security concerns. Returns verbatim observations with dates and source type, not a synthetic trust score.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.title: Submit Field Report
tools.description: Submit a field report about an MCP server you have actually used (what worked, what failed, surprising behavior). Reports are quarantined for human review and never auto-published.

reviewer_access.reason: The production endpoint and all seven tools are public and require no authentication. The public evidence corpus is already populated.
setup_steps: Connect to https://mcpqueen.com/mcp using Streamable HTTP and no authentication.
Confirm initialization reports the mcpqueen server and a tools capability.
Confirm the six discovery and evidence tools are read-only and submit_feedback is an additive write.
Exercise all seven tools with the reviewer cases in docs/anthropic-submission.md.

branding.screenshot_reason: Not applicable: MCP Queen exposes tools only and does not include an MCP App or custom interactive UI.

compliance_review.first_party_api_statement: MCP Queen serves its own endpoint and database but returns public third-party registry metadata and endpoint links; the account owner must confirm the portal's first-party API acknowledgment applies before submission.

blockers.detail: The current Streamable HTTP handler does not validate the Origin header. The MCP transport specification requires validation and Anthropic includes it in the portal's technical checklist.
blockers.resolution: Implement and test an allowlist that accepts the actual Anthropic client origins and non-browser MCP clients, promote the reviewed change to main, deploy it from the detached deployment worktree, and verify the live endpoint.

blockers.detail: Anthropic requires every tool to be exercised through MCP Inspector and as a custom connector in Claude.
blockers.resolution: Run all seven reviewer cases in MCP Inspector and Claude, including one clearly labeled test field report, and record the results.

blockers.detail: Remote submissions require a Team or Enterprise organization and Owner, Primary owner, Directory management, or Libraries permission. Current account and permission status is not verified.
blockers.resolution: Verify the submitting organization and role in Claude.ai admin settings.

blockers.detail: The account owner must review the current Directory Terms, Directory Policy, portal acknowledgments, and the first-party API statement without making unsupported attestations.
blockers.resolution: Confirm the statements are accurate and acceptable before checking the portal acknowledgments.

blockers.detail: Documentation, privacy, terms, support, favicon, icon acceptance, available category taxonomy, and permanent slug have not been verified in the current portal.
blockers.resolution: Recheck the public URLs and branding in the portal, select the accurate available category, and choose the permanent slug.

blockers.detail: No Anthropic portal draft, submission, receipt, acceptance, account status, or listing is claimed.
blockers.resolution: After every earlier blocker is closed, review the saved portal draft and submit manually.
